behaviors.title: Combine discovery, current liveness and evidence-backed fit into a private next-action queue
Bind resume and application artifacts to explicit source proof and supported formats
Block submission without explicit policy, eligible adapter and resolved required answers
Keep prepared, question-blocked and timeout states distinct from confirmed submission
Keep post-application outreach evidence, drafting and delivery status distinct
Project actionable queue state without implicit submission or unknown-state success
Temporary-root fixtures select configured resume lanes, formats and manifest fields and reject missing or per-job lane registration
Synthetic copy preserves selected numeric/URL tokens and rejects missing receipts, altered output and dash-style violations
